verification_instructions: 1. Run npx expo start. 2. Press J to open React Native DevTools. 3. Add log() calls to components. 4. Verify logs appear in DevTools Console tab. 5. Check Sentry breadcrumbs appear in dashboard.
environment_constraints: Dev-only logs must be stripped in production builds via __DEV__ global. Sentry breadcrumbs must respect existing scrubbing rules.
contribution_requirements: Must use npx expo install for packages. Follow existing patterns in src/lib/sentry.ts (scrubEvent, scrubBreadcrumb). Keep DevTools dev-only.
key_patterns: 1. Use __DEV__ to conditionally run dev-only code. 2. Attach Sentry breadcrumbs via addBreadcrumb. 3. Follow existing module structure in src/lib/. 4. Export utility from index if creating one. 5. Use TypeScript strict mode.
directory_structure: src/lib/ contains core utilities (config, sentry, query-client, supabase, analytics). src/features/ contains feature-specific hooks/components. Routes live in app/.
